mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the neighbor link was most worthwhile: Asha's correction made the two-way exchange concrete, while the job stayed open.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the handset before connecting the radio link was a mildly frustrating dead end; it gave no clue about the missing connection.

surprise.text: Tin Row's CLOSED meant RECEIVED rather than completed, a small translation difference with serious consequences for an unfinished request.

arbitrary.text: The need to connect the gateway to the existing clinic radio link was not obvious to me before inspecting it, although the resulting connection made sense.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical repair and the test of how neighboring systems interpret requests made me curious about what happens next, though the failed handset attempt interrupted the flow.
